migration.description: Introduce a durable prompt-cache conversation master and compact proxy invocation identity allocation.
migration.release_unit_description: Backend PR1 for conversation and invoke ID redesign.

durable_state.description: Prompt-cache conversation identity rows and delayed aggregate statistics derived from retained proxy invocations, with a durable refresh queue and freshness marker for restart recovery.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite prompt_cache_conversations table, prompt_cache_conversation_stats_refresh_queue table, codex_invocations mutation triggers, and schema_refresh_migrations markers for identity backfill and aggregate-statistics freshness.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create prompt_cache_conversations, its constraints, and lookup indexes.
Create the durable prompt-cache statistics refresh queue and codex_invocations mutation triggers that enqueue affected keys and invalidate freshness.

dml_changes.description: Materialize aggregate fields from retained codex_invocations after identity rows exist, drain the affected refresh-queue keys only after the rebuild succeeds, and record a freshness marker only when no durable refresh obligation remains.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: Create one normalized prompt-cache master per historical prompt-cache key and record an idempotent completion marker.

progress_signals: Structured migration start/completion logs with candidate and backfilled counts.
Structured identity creation, collision retry, database recovery, statistics refresh, and retention release logs.

The prompt_cache_conversations_stats_v2 marker identifies a completed aggregate refresh only when the prompt_cache_conversation_stats_refresh_queue is empty; its absence or a pending queue triggers a paged startup rebuild.
pause_points: Backfill may re-enter before the schema marker is written; existing identities are recognized and remaining keys continue.
Statistics refresh runs after terminal or derived batch commit and can be retried independently.

SQLite invocation mutation triggers enqueue affected prompt-cache keys and remove the freshness marker in the source transaction; startup recovery can rebuild aggregates and identities after a stopped release.

required_test_evidence: Legacy codex_invocations without a master table backfill successfully.
Backfill rerun recognizes the marker and does not duplicate identities.
A missing prompt-cache statistics marker rebuilds aggregates during the next schema startup.
An invocation payload update enqueues its prompt-cache key and startup recovery creates the missing identity before rebuilding aggregates.
A cache miss recovers the next sequence from retained invocation IDs.
Retention releases orphan masters without a permanent ID blacklist.
